# Fenced HTML is code

The following snippet shows HTML that the reader can copy verbatim.
It is documentation, not active content:

```html
<details>
  <summary>Click to expand</summary>
  Hidden content.
</details>
```

The next example IS active content that we translate:

<details>
  <summary>Resumen plegable</summary>
  Contenido activo que el lector ve.
</details>
